notes: initial state selected from ResetCapture evidence across 9 independent reset(s); reset_verified=true
Guards and effects are selected from observations and checked against every observation of the same branch; insufficient evidence leaves conditions unknown.
Every rule carries provenance: supporting and contradictory observations, competing guard/effect hypotheses, and state-update identifiability claims.
Positive-only properties are recorded as candidate necessary conditions, not treated as proof of sufficiency.
Identifiers are replaced by entity references and allocators; literal values remain only when no relationship explains them.

methodology.reset: verified copy of the pristine fixture before each episode
methodology.metrics: distinct observed transitions, abstract states, new behaviors, failures
methodology.holdout: applications marked holdout contribute no training rows and are reported separately
methodology.reconstruction: hidden workflows replayed against a twin synthesized from held-out training episodes
notes: Every run executes a real Python CLI application in a temporary work directory.
Budget is the number of action invocations, identical for every policy and seed.
Policy only ranks actions; all recorded behavior comes from observation.
A failed run is reported as failed and excluded from means, never scored as zero.
